text_block_list.text:
I came to the shrine with Sakura Chiyono O,
who hasn't been feeling her best lately.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Ardan-san, what a coincidence.
Are you here to pray?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, just taking a stroll.
A guardian dog statue caught my eye, so I'm examining it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Big and dependable, yet so gentle...
It somehow reminds me of the therapy dog
who took care of me when I was little.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: A therapy dog is a pup that stays by your side when you're sick, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Back when my body was frail and I couldn't go outside,
she would sometimes come over to visit
and play with me a lot.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Remembering it
made me want to see them again.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Heh~, that's true. Even when you're feeling down,
having a dog around really puts a smile on your face.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, then why don't we all go to a dog cafe right now?
You can drink tea and play with all kinds of doggies!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My, there's such a lovely shop?
I would love to join you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's okay with you too, right, Trainer-san?!
Well then, I'm going to go finish offering my prayers!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"May I keep running in good spirits!
And may good things come to everyone...!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting!
I went ahead and looked up the dog cafe's regular closing days, and—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank goodness.
It's open... wait, WHAAA!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: This is terrible! It looks like they're holding an event at the dog café, but what they're doing is—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: It looks like they're putting paint on paw pads to make art...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: My, that sounds like so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Just imagining it overflows with cuteness!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, maybe visiting the shrine really worked.
Something great happened right away!

Sakura Chiyono O felt refreshed and radiant,
and after that, she was right back in top form!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
What... Temporarily closed...!?
Trainer-san, Ardan-san, it looks like the dog cafe is off for today...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Is that so...?
Well, maybe next time, then...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I was totally in the mood
to pet a doggy with all my might, but...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...How on earth am I supposed to let all these feelings out...?
In the end, Sakura Chiyono O remained feeling down...
